claims.text: The proposed model using ELMo embeddings achieves improved performance in fine-grained named entity classification compared to existing systems.
The model learns representations for entity mentions based on context and incorporates Wikidata to enhance label granularity.
The architecture utilizes a residual LSTM and softmax layer for predicting entity types, demonstrating effective learning of morphological representations.
